description: Look up orders placed with the signed-in account's email — the latest ones, or one by its number — with status, total and a tracking page url. Use it for 'where is my order'; for an order not placed yet use get_order_preview. status is e.g. draft (unpaid, from prepare_order), pending_payment, paid, in_production, shipped, delivered or cancelled. number is the full order number such as AO-261023-1234; without it you get the newest orders first (limit default 5, max 20). Read-only: it can't cancel or change an order. An account with no email returns an empty list and a note.

number.description: Exact order number to look up, e.g. AO-261023-1234; omit for the most recent orders.

name: get_order_status

note.description: Present when the account has no email on file.

title: Check order status
